title: 12 Best Natural Wine Bars in Abu Dhabi
description: Discover Abu Dhabi's top natural wine bars for 2026. From chic lounges to upscale restaurants, find biodynamic and organic wine selections in the UAE's capital. Your guide to sustainable sips.

places.name: LPM Restaurant & Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A bottle of unfiltered Jura Chardonnay from their 'Natural Gems' selection, paired with their iconic Burrata with cherry tomatoes and basil.

places.name: COYA Abu Dhabi
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A glass of natural Albariño from Rías Baixas, perfectly paired with the Atún Chifa (tuna with sesame rice crackers) or the classic Guacamole prepared fresh at your table.

places.name: Oak Room
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A natural, savory Cabernet Franc or a unique Pinot Noir from their 'Sommelier's Handpick' list, expertly paired with one of their dry-aged steaks.

places.name: Paradiso
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A light, naturally fermented Vermentino or a biodynamic Rosé, perfectly complementing their signature Pizza Paradiso or fresh seafood pasta.

places.name: Annex
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Explore their rotating selection of natural wines by the glass, often featuring funky Pét-Nats or vibrant skin-contact wines, paired with their Wagyu beef sliders.

places.name: Talea by Antonio Guida
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Allow the sommelier to recommend a rare natural Barolo or a high-altitude Sicilian natural wine to complement a pasta dish like their Cacio e Pepe.

places.name: Fouquet's Abu Dhabi
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A natural Sancerre or a biodynamic Beaujolais Cru, paired with their famous Steak Frites or the Sea Bream with artichokes.

places.name: Penso
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A crisp, natural Greek Assyrtiko or a light-bodied Corsican red, paired with their grilled octopus or a vibrant superfood salad.

places.name: Mazi Abu Dhabi
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A unique orange wine made from Greek grapes like Malagousia or Roditis, to accompany their Kleftiko (lamb shank) or the Mazi Salad.

places.name: The Lighthouse Restaurant & Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A refreshing natural Rosé or a zesty biodynamic Sauvignon Blanc, paired with their popular baked feta or the grilled halloumi salad.

places.name: Niri Restaurant & Bar
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A crisp, low-intervention Grüner Veltliner or a vibrant dry Riesling (often found in natural wine selections) to pair with their signature Niri Maki or fresh sashimi platter.

places.name: Hakkasan
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A natural, earthy Pinot Noir or a unique skin-contact white wine to contrast with the rich Black Pepper Beef or the delicate Dim Sum Platter.
